privacy.pageDescription: Privacy policy and personal data processing of UTB OpenDict
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introText: UTB OpenDict is committed to protecting your privacy and personal data. This policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when using our services.
privacy.collectText: We collect the following types of information:
privacy.collectPersonalItem1: Name and email address when you register an account
privacy.collectPersonalItem2: Profile picture and profile information (if you provide it)
privacy.collectPersonalItem3: Authentication information via Google (if you log in with Google)
privacy.collectUsageItem1: Search history and terms you view
privacy.collectUsageItem3: IP address, browser type, operating system
privacy.useItem1: Provide, operate, and improve UTB OpenDict services
privacy.useItem3: Send notifications about updates, security, and technical support
privacy.useItem4: Analyze usage trends and develop new features
privacy.useItem5: Prevent fraud and ensure system security
privacy.sharingText: We do not sell your personal information. Information is only shared in the following cases:
privacy.sharingItem2: With trusted service providers supporting UTB OpenDict operations
privacy.sharingItem4: To protect the rights, property, or safety of UTB OpenDict and users
privacy.securityText: We apply appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, loss, or disclosure. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure.
privacy.cookiesText: UTB OpenDict uses cookies to improve user experience, store preferences, and analyze traffic. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, but this may affect some features.
privacy.rightsItem1: Access and receive a copy of your personal data
privacy.rightsItem2: Request correction or update of inaccurate information
privacy.rightsItem3: Delete your account and data (subject to legal requirements)
privacy.rightsItem5: File a complaint with data protection authorities if you believe your rights have been violated
privacy.childrenText: UTB OpenDict does not knowingly collect information from users under 13 years of age. If you discover that a child has provided personal information to us, please contact us to delete that information.
privacy.changesText: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Changes will be effective immediately upon posting on this page. We encourage you to review the policy regularly.
privacy.contactText: If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact:

aboutPage.metaDescription: Learn about UTB OpenDict, our mission, key features, and community values.
aboutPage.title: About UTB OpenDict
aboutPage.subtitle: UTB OpenDict is a multilingual open dictionary platform for Vietnamese, Lao, and English where the community contributes, reviews, and shares knowledge.
aboutPage.missionText: We built UTB OpenDict to help everyone look up terms quickly, accurately, and accessibly, especially for learning and professional use.
aboutPage.visionText: To become a trusted open dictionary ecosystem for users in Vietnam and Laos by combining community collaboration with AI-powered support.
aboutPage.feature4: Favorites, search history, and profile management
aboutPage.communityText: Content on UTB OpenDict is built through user contributions and moderation workflows to keep it useful, context-aware, and easy to understand.
aboutPage.contactText: If you would like to collaborate, send feedback, or report an issue, please contact the UTB OpenDict team via email:

userGuide.metaDescription: Learn how to use UTB OpenDict dictionary system effectively
userGuide.title: User Guide
userGuide.subtitle: A comprehensive guide to help you get the most out of UTB OpenDict
userGuide.searchDesc: Enter any term in the search bar on the homepage. The system supports searching in Vietnamese, Lao, and English. Results will show exact matches and related terms.
userGuide.contributeDesc: Click 'Contribute' in the navigation menu. Fill in the term, definition, and select a category. You can add content in multiple languages. A moderator will review your contribution.
userGuide.aiDesc: When a term is not found, you can ask the AI assistant for information. Click 'Ask AI' to get definitions, explanations, and examples. You can then contribute the AI-suggested term to the dictionary.
userGuide.favoritesDesc: Click the heart icon on any term to save it to your favorites. Access your favorites from the navigation menu to quickly find saved terms.
userGuide.accountDesc: Register an account to access all features. You can manage your profile, view your contributions, and track your search history.
userGuide.languageDesc: Use the language selector in the header to switch between Vietnamese, Lao, and English. The entire interface will update to your selected language.

faq.metaDescription: Frequently asked questions about UTB OpenDict dictionary system
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about using UTB OpenDict
faq.a1: UTB OpenDict is a multilingual open dictionary system developed by Tay Bac University. It supports quick and convenient lookup of specialized Vietnamese - Lao - English terms.
faq.q2: How do I search for a term?
faq.a2: Simply type the term you're looking for in the search bar on the homepage. The system will search across all supported languages and show matching results.
faq.q3: How can I contribute a term?
faq.a3: After logging in, click 'Contribute' in the navigation menu. Fill in the term and definition in at least one language, select a category, and submit it for review.
faq.a4: UTB OpenDict currently supports three languages: Vietnamese, Lao, and English. You can search and contribute terms in any of these languages.
faq.q5: How does the AI feature work?
faq.a5: When a term is not found in the dictionary, you can ask the AI assistant for information. The AI will provide definitions, examples, and related terms that you can then contribute to the dictionary.
faq.a6: Contributions are reviewed by moderators assigned to specific categories. They will approve or provide feedback on your submission.
faq.q7: How can I become a moderator?
faq.a7: You can register as a moderator through our Contact page. Select 'Register as Moderator/Reviewer' and provide relevant information about your expertise.
faq.a8: Yes. We use encryption, secure authentication, and follow best practices for data protection. Please refer to our Privacy Policy for more details.
